required_fields_per_bar.config_id: hash or version of msip_shadow config
required_fields_per_bar.dimension_sources: map dimension_id → list of {feature, fm_id?, value_hash_or_value}
required_fields_per_bar.parity_audit_refs: list of audit artifact IDs used
